module: Flowgraph editor helper for grouping and ungrouping selected nodes. For a flow graph, the group becomes a subgraph (or sub-macro) represented by a macro/integrated node; for a state graph, it becomes a group state. The file also contains functions to center nodes based on their position in the editor. The module returns a constructor: require('/lua/ge/extensions/flowgraph/groupHelper')(mgr).
notes: Editor use only: relies on mgr.selectedNodes and ui_flowgraph_editor (GetNodeSize, GetNodePosition).
A node of size 0x0 is treated as 200 x 100.
Bug: ungroupSelection calls self:ungroupFlowNode(), which is defined nowhere in the file; ungrouping a flow node therefore raises a Lua error.
groupFlowNodes returns the integrated node created.

C.desc: Object returned by the constructor; keeps the manager in self.mgr.

getRectCenter.desc: Computes the bounding rectangle of the nodes and its center.

centerNodes.desc: Repositions a set of nodes around a position while keeping their relative positions (grid alignment).

centerMultiNodes.desc: Centers moveNodes on the center of the bounding rectangle of fixNodes.

createGroupingFromSelection.desc: Groups the selection: groupStateNodes in a state graph, otherwise groupFlowNodes.

groupStateNodes.desc: Moves the selected state nodes (except entry and exit) into a new 'new group' state graph and reconnects the incoming and outgoing links via the group node.

groupFlowNodes.desc: Clones the selection into a new subgraph or sub-macro, copies the graph's variables, recreates the internal links and replaces the selection with a macro/integrated node connected to the incoming and outgoing links.

ungroupSelection.desc: Ungroups the selection: ungroupStateNode in a state graph, otherwise ungroupFlowNode (nonexistent, see notes).

ungroupStateNode.desc: Moves the internal nodes (except entry/exit) of a selected group state up into the current graph and restores the links.
